Raw ReportDesign JSON is absent from the normal flow while the trusted Package C reviewed-design boundary remains intact. The browser neither invents nor modifies nor approves nor bypasses a design; if no eligible reviewed design exists, show a truthful unavailable state and an authorised EXPERT review route rather than a synthetic design or second compiler.

An active same-company EXPERT alone may submit an explicit ReportDesign through protected intake. The server records the actual reviewer identity/membership, company, case, confirmed contract, exact request/evidence/context, timestamp, immutable design bytes and digest; the same EXPERT may supply and review for MVP-1. No client-supplied approved flag or validation-as-human-review substitution is accepted.

An authorised normal business user sees only a bounded business-safe reviewed-design summary and opaque reviewed_design_id, never raw design JSON. Generation resolves the immutable design server-side, verifies digest, current membership/access, current confirmation and exact company/case/contract/request/evidence/context eligibility, and fails closed for stale, tampered, foreign or revoked inputs.

Retries remain bound to the same reviewed design; explicit regeneration may select another currently eligible reviewed design, while each durable historical attempt retains its original immutable reviewed-design association.

No report, ready, building, ready, failed, retry, supported cancellation, current version, historical version, stale reconfirmation, denied and unavailable states are truthful, accessible and distinguishable without colour alone.
